SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.TagName = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tags AS t
        WHERE t.TagName = 'r'
          AND instr(p.Tags, '<' || t.TagName || '>') > 0
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u
  ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.TagName = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.TagName = 'r' THEN p.Id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN p.Id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage

JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency

WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'

WITH member_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        m.first_name,
        m.last_name,
        SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS event_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
)
SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM member_spending
WHERE event_count > 1
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, MAX(e.cost) AS max_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.link_to_member IN (
    SELECT e2.link_to_member
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON e2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
)
GROUP BY e.link_to_member
ORDER BY max_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid

JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.link_to_member IN (
    SELECT e2.link_to_member
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON e2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
)
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN budget T3 ON T2.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE b.link_to_event IS NOT NULL
  AND e.link_to_member IN (
      SELECT e2.link_to_member
      FROM expense e2
      JOIN budget b2 ON b2.budget_id = e2.link_to_budget

      GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
  )
GROUP BY e.link_to_member
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1
